 versus
 State Of Nct Delhi ..... Respondent
 Through:
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice C.Hari Shankar
 Order 
% 02.04.2024 1. Mr. J. Amal Anand, learned counsel for the appellants, submits that there is no requirement of framing any substantial question of law in this case as the appeal has been preferred under Section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 under which appeal lies on any question of fact or law. 
2. In view thereof, renotify for disposal at the end of the board on 23 August 2024. 
This is a digitally signed order.

1 3. It is seen that there are no written submissions forthcoming from the respondent. Learned counsel for the Respondent is directed to place on record short notes of its respective submissions not exceeding five pages each, after exchanging copies with each other at least a week in advance of the next date of hearing. 
4. Interim order to continue till the next date of hearing.
